question: A cube made of edge 18 m is completely filled with milk. The milk is transferred into a cuboid of length 27 m and height 7 m. The width of the cuboid is
solution:
**Given:**

A cube with an edge of 18 m is completely filled with milk. The milk is transferred into a cuboid of length 27 m and height 7 m.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cube = side³

Volume of a cuboid = length × width × height

**Calculation:**

We have,

⇒ Volume of the cube = (18)³ m³

⇒ Volume of the cube = 5832 m³

⇒ Volume of the cuboid = 27 m × width × 7 m

⇒ Volume of the cuboid = 189 m × width

Since the volume of the cube equals the volume of the cuboid:

⇒ 5832 m³ = 189 m × width

⇒ width = 5832 m³ / 189 m

⇒ width = 30.8 m

**∴ The width of the cuboid is 30.8 m, which corresponds to option 1.**
